newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-S&P assigns rating to PacifiCorp Australia.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-S&P assigns rating to PacifiCorp Australia.

text.p: SYDNEY, March 6 (Reuter) Standard & Poor's said it has assigned its BBB+ long-term and A-2 short-term corporate credit ratings to PacifiCorp Australia.
The ratings are constrained by the notional group rating of BBB+/A-2 of its U.S. parent PacifiCorp Holdings Inc and subsidiaries.

The stand-alone credit quality of PacifiCorp Australia reflects the operations of its primary subsidiary, Powercor Australia Limited, which operates an electricty distribution and retailing business under a clear regulatory framework, S&P said.
Powercorp has a diverse customer base and is insulated from competitive pressure in its franchise electricity network business.
PacifiCorp Australia had a modest, but improving, financial profile and without the parental constraint, PacifiCorp Australia's rating would be A-minus/A-2, S&P added.
